title: opt: introduce fused-attention kernels with rotary/rope precompute and scheduling tweaks
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduce new fused attention kernels that combine QKV projection, rotary/ROPE application, and scaled dot-product compute into a single CUDA path. Default preserves existing behavior; opt-in via runtime kernel selector. Expected perf gains in production: 1.4-2.5x depending on sequence length and batch shape.
description: Motivation: current attention implementation applies QKV projection, rotary/ROPE, and attention scoring as separate kernels which increases memory traffic and kernel launch overhead under continuous batching. This PR introduces a new fused-attention CUDA path that: 1) fuses QKV matmuls and bias-add into a single launch when shapes permit; 2) applies rotary/ROPE during the same kernel pass to avoid an intermediate buffer; 3) integrates FlashAttention-style block reduction and optional causal mask fast path; 4) exposes a new scheduling hint to the continuous batching subsystem so fused work can be coalesced for better occupancy. Changes: added kernels/cuda/fused_attn_v2.cu with fallback scalar paths, updated runtime/attn/kernel_selector.cc to include a selector that scores candidate kernels by estimated memory traffic, latency and KV cache compatibility, modified runtime/kv_cache/kv_cache_manager.cc to support segmented KV writes when fused kernels stream outputs directly into shard-compatible layout, added a new runtime flag REDWOOD_ATTN_KERNEL_MODE (values: auto,fused,legacy) and model-level config allow_fused_attention, added unit and integration tests under tests/attn_fused/* and microbenchmarks under bench/attn_fused_bench.py. Performance: microbenchmarks on c6i-gpu-32 show 1.6x median latency improvement for short sequences (<=128) and up to 2.3x for long sequences (>=2048) under 8 batch continuous batching with KV caching enabled; peak GPU memory reduction ~18% due to avoiding temporaries. Compatibility: default is auto which keeps legacy kernel for models or shapes not yet supported. The fused path supports rotary/ROPE and rotary caching for causal generation. Rollout: feature gated with staged canary: 5% of requests go to fused path during first week, then 25%, then allow model-override. Metrics and fallbacks: added runtime metrics fused_attn.success_count fused_attn.fallback_count and latency histograms; failing kernels fall back to legacy kernel automatically. Testing: all new kernels validated against existing attention reference implementation with randomized tensor tests and deterministic seeds. CI: added new GPU unit job attn-fused-ci that runs on our nightly GPU CI pool. Related: follows-up on ENG-942 and addresses support ticket SUP-4127. TODO: follow-up PR to add ROCm variants and additional kernel autotuning table.
